name: hcportal_getPermissionMatrix
description: Loads the data-driven permission matrix (Permissions V2) for the super-admin editor: the function catalog, the grantor catalog (mismanagement roles + app-access flags; SuperAdmin bypass excluded), and the current GLOBAL grants. Auth via ValidatePortalAuth; caller must hold SuperAdmin (0x40000000) in some kennel.

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: Auth: device ID used to resolve the hasher and validate the token.

parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: Auth: short-lived portal token validated via ValidatePortalAuth.

parameters.name: publicKennelId
parameters.description: When set, rowset 4 returns that kennel's override rows (else empty).

rowsets.name: Envelope
rowsets.description: { Success, ErrorMessage }. Success=0 on auth failure or when caller is not a super admin.

rowsets.name: Functions
rowsets.description: Function catalog (matrix columns). Present only when Success=1.

columns.name: HareScoped
columns.description: 1 if a run's hare also gets it

rowsets.name: Grantors
rowsets.description: Grantor catalog (matrix rows: mismanagement roles + app-access flags). Present only when Success=1.

rowsets.name: GlobalGrants
rowsets.description: Current global grants (KennelId NULL, granted). Present only when Success=1.

rowsets.name: KennelOverrides
rowsets.description: The selected kennel's override rows (empty if publicKennelId not supplied). Present only when Success=1.

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
